# sprint issues links

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint issues links — GitHub App connection or explicit mapping through authenticated HTTP; current project authority is rechecked.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint issues links --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  GitHub App connection or explicit mapping through authenticated HTTP; current project authority is rechecked.

EXAMPLES
  sprint issues links --file input.json

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  None; see SYNOPSIS for required input flags.

FLAGS
  --page PAGE
  --limit LIMIT
  --all
  --non-interactive
  --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output records + meta on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  Sprint profile or automation-token file required. Server permissions are authoritative.

NOTES
  Examples use placeholder IDs and files; replace them with authorized current values.
  JSON payload: {"name":"string; --title maps to name","projectId":"project ID or authorized exact name","teamId?":"work-team ID, prefix or authorized exact name; changing it preserves UUID and aliases","estimate?":"nonnegative finite number","status":"todo | doing | review | done","priority":"낮음 | 보통 | 높음 | 긴급","description?":"string","sprintId?":"same-project sprint ID or current active sprint in the selected project","assigneeId?":"me | active authorized member ID, email or unique exact name | null","labelIds?":"same-project label ID[]","date?":"YYYY-MM-DD due date","parentBacklogId?":"same-project PBL ID","rank?":"positive integer; reorders project peers","period?":"native PBL period string","taskType?":"개발 | 이외"}
  API action: githubLinks.list
  JSON input for --json-data/--file: {"type":"object","properties":{"issueReference":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":500},"page":{"type":"integer","minimum":1},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":200}},"required":["issueReference"],"additionalProperties":false}
```
